business_summary: MECOM Power and Construction Limited offers construction services in Macau, Hong Kong, Cyprus, and the People's Republic of China. It provides steel structure erection services, including structural steel works, concreting and builder works, and integration of constructional methods; civil engineering construction services, such as cover demolition, ground field investigation, site formation, and foundation works, as well as substructures and superstructures, roads, and drainage works; and fitting out and improvement works, comprising alteration, renovation and upgrading works, shop drawings, modification, removal and installation of equipment, and general improvement works. The company also offers high voltage power substation construction and system installation works, including planning, project management, scheduling, and construction services. In addition, it provides electrical and mechanical (E&M) engineering services, which includes the supply and/or installation of low voltage systems works, such as supply and installation of cables, earthing, lighting systems, power cables, electrical wiring, switchboards, power outlets, and others; heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems works; and extra low voltage systems works, and related testing and commissioning, as well as management and monitoring of quality and delivery of E&M engineering service works. Further, the company offers facilities operation and maintenance management, alteration, upgrading, maintenance works, and emergency repair of various buildings and properties, as well as high voltage power substations and related systems. Additionally, it designs, produces, sells, and markets EV charging systems; produces battery packs; and provides EV charging facilities. MECOM Power and Construction Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Macau. MECOM Power and Construction Limited is a subsidiary of MECOM Holding Limited.
